acceptanceCriteria: A turn.completed event whose input_tokens or output_tokens is null makes ObservedUsage report unobserved.
A repeated or case-folded usage member makes ObservedUsage report unobserved.
Maintained tests cover null, repeated and case-folded counters on the supervised Codex host.
body:
Filed 2026-10-07 by the orchestrator session from the beamfall/corvint#652 lane (branch claude/gh652, base 79536edd, head 58f843f2; go1.27.1). Confirmed by reading the code.

internal/tasks/supervisor/events.go ObservedUsage decodes `input_tokens` and `output_tokens` with json.Unmarshal into uint64. A JSON `null` decodes without error and leaves 0, so a turn.completed event with null counters is reported as KNOWN zero usage. The usage object is a map, so a repeated or case-folded member is silently collapsed. Expected (matching CAL-V0-157 in the dispatch budget parser): null, repeated or case-folded counters make usage unobserved, never zero. Actual: 0 is reported.
title: supervisor: ObservedUsage reads a null Codex usage counter as 0 and accepts repeated or case-folded usage members
